transfer_provisions.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of any other Executive Order, the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act which are applicable to the committees listed in Sections 1 and 2 of this Order, except that of reporting annually to the Congress, shall be performed by the head of the department or agency designated after each committee
transfer_provisions.note: Reaches only the committees continued in secs. 1 and 2 (thirteen in sec. 1 and the NSTAC in sec. 2). None of the committees revoked in sec. 4 is in secs. 1-2, so the FACA transfer carries nothing of the four batch orders.

exceptions.quote: The following Executive Orders, that established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed, are revoked
exceptions.note: A recital of why the orders are revoked, not a limit on the revocation. It does not decide when each committee actually ceased, so each committee's own termination term must be tested against the revocation date (sec. 6).

exceptions.quote: (a) Section 2(d) of Executive Order No. 12039 ... (k) Section 1-2 of Executive Order No. 12137, as amended
exceptions.note: The only two PARTIAL items in sec. 4. They explain why the machine tags sec. 4 'partial'. Items (e), (g), (i) and (j), the batch targets, name a whole Executive order with no section limit.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 6 says 'This Order shall be effective December 31,1982.' The order was signed December 31, 1982 (printed 48 FR 379-380, January 5, 1983), so the revocations in sec. 4 are effective December 31, 1982, the signing date. The sec. 4 revocations have no other delayed-effect or phase-in wording.

conclusion: EO 12399 (signed 1982-12-31, 48 FR 379-380, PDF pages 9-10, read once in full) continues thirteen advisory committees to September 30, 1984 (sec. 1) and the NSTAC to December 31, 1983 (sec. 2), moves the FACA functions for those fourteen to the designated agency heads (sec. 3), revokes eleven Executive orders or parts of orders that established committees 'which have terminated or whose work is completed' (sec. 4(a)-(k)), supersedes EO 12258 (sec. 5) and makes the order effective December 31, 1982 (sec. 6). Items 4(e), (g), (i) and (j) revoke the four batch orders whole, effective December 31, 1982. The order has no savings, pending-matter or exception clause for the revoked committees. Its only transfer wording (sec. 3) is limited to the continued committees.
